title: Recyclable and Low Fat Products
notes: Simple just read the question and apply constraints
code:
SELECT 
    product_id
FROM 
    Products
WHERE 
    low_fats = 'Y' AND recyclable = 'Y';

title: Find Customer Referee
notes: Simple just read the question and apply constraints
code:
SELECT
    name
FROM 
    Customer
WHERE
    referee_id IS NULL OR referee_id != 2;
